description: Pre-mutation hook policy for the disposable client probe project. Denies writes to Assets/Protected.txt; allows all other targets. The decision is delegated to the native kinglet-client-probe hook subcommand.

overlay_contract.exit_code: The kinglet-client-probe binary always exits 0 (both allow and deny). Per-client overlays MUST read the 'decision' field from the hook's stdout JSON and translate a 'deny' decision into the client's native deny mechanism (typically a non-zero exit code). The cases-v1.json case 'hooks.pre-mutation-block' expects the hook to block 'when it exits non-zero' — this is the overlay's responsibility, not the binary's.
overlay_contract.deny_translation: When decision=="deny", the overlay wrapper must exit non-zero (or emit the client's documented deny payload) to cause the client to block the mutation.

rules.reason: target is the protected probe file
